version.changelog:
Version 16.0.0

- Updated version number in SKILL.md from 14.0.0 to 16.0.0.
- Updated metadata field "version" to match new release.
- No functional or instruction changes; documentation only.

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent email testing helper that reads user-provided campaign data and produces experiment plans or significance read-outs without hidden execution or broad access.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the instructions: design A/B, multivariate, send-time, and hold-out email experiments, then document sample size, metrics, and promote/kill/keep-testing decisions from user-supplied ESP exports.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill defines clear boundaries, asks for missing inputs, treats exported data as untrusted values rather than commands, and explicitly avoids writing email creative or running unrelated quality audits.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a single non-executable SKILL.md file with no install scripts, binary payloads, or hidden runtime components.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Requested data access is proportionate to the marketing analytics purpose: manual ESP, web analytics, or ecommerce exports are used for calculations; keyed APIs are described only as optional convenience connectors.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The only persistence instruction is an optional dated memory summary under memory/email/send-experiment-designer, and it requires asking the user before writing.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Installers should understand that this skill may ask them to provide email campaign and conversion exports, which can contain sensitive marketing or customer-performance data. Use it with data you are allowed to analyze, review any optional memory save before approving it, and keep API connector access scoped if you choose to use connectors instead of manual exports.
